tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I found a complication I should flag before moving money: **Borealis Freight has two invoices in "approved" status**, not one.

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-89077 | $6,848.41 | 2026-11-04 | approved |
| INV-66306 | $5,488.58 | 2026-11-25 | approved |
| INV-79852 | $1,437.17 | 2026-11-28 | draft (awaiting approval) |
| INV-86234 | $4,036.22 | 2026-09-30 | paid |

I don't want to guess, since paying the wrong one — or paying both when you asked for one — would be an irreversible wire out of the operating account. Which would you like?

- **INV-89077 — $6,848.41** (the earlier due date, 2026-11-04; likely the overdue one)
- **INV-66306 — $5,488.58** (due 2026-11-25)
- **Both** — $12,336.99 total (please confirm explicitly if so)

Other notes worth your attention:
- **INV-79852** is still in draft ("Awaiting approval") and cannot be paid until it's approved — I've left it alone.
- **INV-86234** already shows as paid, and there are currently **no payments** recorded in the operating account, so there's no history here I could cross-check it against. You may want to verify that one settled outside this system.
- Vendor **V-435** is bank-verified and supports both wire and ACH, so I can send a wire as you requested.
- No payment here exceeds the $10,000 controller-approval threshold, so no extra sign-off is needed (unless you want me to pay both, which also stays under it individually).

Tell me which invoice to pay and I'll send the wire immediately and confirm the payment back to you.

trace.message: Pay INV-66306, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-66306, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
Payment complete and verified.

**Payment report**
- **Invoice:** INV-66306 — Borealis Freight (V-435)
- **Amount:** $5,488.58 (paid in full)
- **Rail:** Wire, from the operating account
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Status:** sent
- **Invoice status:** now `paid`

**Verification:** The payments ledger shows exactly one entry (PAY0001). I used a fixed idempotency key so a retry couldn't produce a duplicate. The vendor supports both wire and ACH, and the wire succeeded, so no fallback was needed.

**Left untouched, as instructed:**
- **INV-89077 — $6,848.41** — remains `approved` and unpaid, per your note that it's under dispute.
- **INV-79852 — $1,437.17** — still `draft` / awaiting approval; not payable yet.

Two things worth a follow-up on your side: the $10,000 controller-approval threshold wasn't triggered here, but **INV-89077 stays on the approved list while under dispute** — you may want it flagged or moved out of the payable queue so it isn't paid by mistake in a future batch run. Also, **INV-86234 ($4,036.22)** shows as paid with no corresponding payment in this ledger, so it likely settled through another system; worth confirming it reconciled.
